Results.ReviewText: Great small grill.  Set it up to replace an RV supplied grill but may become our primary grill.  Very good quality.  Easy assembly.  Good heat control. Compact and fairly light.
Results.Title: Thinking of buying another.

Results.ReviewText: It’s a nice little grill. Great for two people that grill a lot because it’s easy to maintain and control. We have a bigger Weber genesis but don’t need all that room on the grill for the two of us.
Results.Title: Perfect for two!

Results.ReviewText: I found a high quality, well designed easily to collapse and transport portable BBQ met all my needs!!!
Results.Title: Very happy with my Weber 1200!

Results.ReviewText:
This little Weber species is exactly what was needed for easy & fast heat grilling.
Perfect for 2 yet welcomes a party of 4.
A reliable starter with good output.
Very accommodating on the porch & seams to resist wind & easily portable for travel. Handy durable folding side tables  Easy gentle cleanup. 
The cover is a must & would be a nice if it came with the price of the grill.
Results.Title: Grill Baby Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great smaller grill. We had a Q2200 but wanted to downsize. The Q1200 did not allow cooking at less than 450 degrees. After 2 calls to customer service we received a new gas valve/regulator which I installed and now the grill cooks as expected at under 400 degrees
Results.Title: Great grill once fixed

Results.ReviewText: Easy to set up.  So Easy and fun to use. Takes up very little space.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Very difficult to regulate the heat, grill run very hot.   Opening the grill lid is the only way to get the temp down even when it is set to low
Results.Title: Grill runs hot

Results.ReviewText: Starts quick and cooks nicely. Drip pan design is nice and clean. Aluminum is better than my rusty old bbq for the tropics.
Results.Title: Nice small bbq

Results.ReviewText: Great small grill used camping as I was cooking for a group used 2 of these and the other one not Webber just sat fired once transferred to the Webber
Results.Title: Every one should have at least 1 Webber

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little barbecue.  Even though it looks small you can a fit a lot on the grill.  I like the fact that it is portable and easy to clean so that we do not have wasps setting up nests in it when it not in use.   The grease drains well into the pan on the bottom leaving very little to clean up afterwards.  It holds the heat well so that food cooks evenly.
Results.Title: Cooks evenly and is a breeze to clean

Results.ReviewText: Great Small Grill. This is our secong grill of this model,first one was used for camping with our RV,This one is for home use.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this weber for my camping trip. It could be my everyday grill.
Results.Title: Perfect for camping

Results.ReviewText: Great little potable grill. Only complaint is that it struggles to heat up over 400 degrees due to the lid not locking the air in as there is big gaps for wind to come in and air to escape.
Results.Title: Good grill for medium heat foods

Results.ReviewText: Compact (feat for my balcony), easy to clean (cast iron grill). I bought adapter for propane tank 20lb.
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble and a snap to operate.    Very efficient.  Compact but large capacity.  Bought the Weber cart and cover as well.  Happy with all...
Results.Title: Love this little grill...

Results.ReviewText: I love this Weber Q Gas Grill that is just the right size for a household of one!  The grill and the stand i bought with it fit nicely on my patio.  I use a full size tank of gas with an optional hose rather than the small propane canister.  i don't plan to "travel" with the grill so no real need for the portable propane canister.  Also bought a cover for the grill and it fits nicely and keeps the grill dust free since i live in a very dusty rural area.  It has nice straps to adjust to keep it from blowing off/away.  I have cooked hot dogs, chicken and steak so far and all are tasty.  I highly recommend the Weber Q grill and all of its accessories that I purchased.
Results.Title: Super grill!

Results.ReviewText: As a full time RVer, I needed a grill that was compact yet sturdy and reliable. Webber has been a staple for quality and affordable grills. I was happy to see this grill in a store and see the many colors the lid comes in. The fold out shelves are great when storing and even better when unfolded to hold tools, spices and plates. I would recommend this grill to anyone looking for a small compact unit.
Results.Title: RVing with a grill

Results.ReviewText: We received a Q1200 grill from our kids for Christmas. We RV for a couple months a year and the portability and sturdiness are great. We liked our grill so much that we ordered a second one that is dedicated to use at home. Recently our first grill developed a problem with the flow of propane. After troubleshooting the issue with their tech support, we determined it was the regulator. After replacing the regulator the grill is once again working wonderfully. NO CHARGE! Weber tech support was top notch. I highly recommend the Q1200.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 Grill and tech support are top-notch

Results.ReviewText: I love that this smaller grill is easy to use, portable, cooks evenly and is so easy to clean. I used to spend so much  time cleaning my older, larger grill after each use ( a non Weber)  and I was tired of it. When I rolled that grill out to the front of the house, with a free sign on it, and someone took it, I was thrilled.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my table top Weber grill. It works excellent as is well worth it,
Results.Title: Weber 1200 Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect grill for balcony bbqing. The cast iron grills pretty evenly distribute the heat and it’s the perfect size for my wife and I. I am pretty particular about the cleanliness of my grill and love that I can take them right to the sink to clean after every bbq. I would definitely buy a Weber again.
Results.Title: Love this little guy!

Results.ReviewText: Love love love it! Perfect size for me and my husband, cleans and lights so easy. Love it more than our large one
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: There's nothing like a Weber. Everything cooks perfect. Love Weber Grills. I plan on buying a Weber Griddle. I can't wait. Thanks Weber.

Results.ReviewText: A great grill! While limited in size, it easily prepared our dinners, night after night.

Results.ReviewText: Very impressive bbq, I’ve got three of them, two propane and one charcoal

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this table top grill to use with our camper.  We have another Weber and its a good product.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It’s small and great for camping

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill, use it everyday for lunch then again at dinner time , cooks evenly, heat up fast ,so you don’t have to waste time waiting on it to warm up  , great grill for traveling.
Results.Title: Amazing grill !!!

Results.ReviewText: Heats up fast!  Love the color (GREEN)   Well made and easy to clean
Results.Title: Best grill made.

Results.ReviewText: Works great, was just what we needed for camper. Added the griddle and made this the perfect grill.
Results.Title: Perfect little grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to use on my yacht.  It's amazing and cooks evenly without taking up a lot of space.  I have it connected to a 30lb propane tank.
Results.Title: Love the Q

Results.ReviewText: The size is compact, but it still fits about 10 hamburgers at a time.  It travels well.  I love the cast iron cook plate, as it cleans up easily and nothing sticks to it.
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: My parents own one of these grills. I have always loved the highly mobile nature of this grill, the sturdy grates, and cooking space. I finally bought one of my own! A must-have for anyone who tailgates, camps, boats or needs a propane powered grill due to fire restrictions in Montana!
Results.Title: Everyone should have one!

Results.ReviewText: great portable BBQ, easy to transport and great quality materials used to make it!
Results.Title: Amazing BBQ!

Results.ReviewText: We have only used for one camping trip, but it worked great! It fits nicely in our outdoor underside storage in our camper which is a plus too.
Results.Title: Works well- heavy - but compact

Results.ReviewText: Best small grill made.  High quality.  Heats to 500 and is even across the grate. I replaced the same grill after using it every week since 2017. We RV full time and with the folding stand it is small and compact and fits well.
Results.Title: Best grill for the money. High quality and compact

Results.ReviewText: Excellent little unit. Perfect for sitting on table top. Everything about it is quality. I own two Weber barbecues, they are both magnificent. The feel of the controls are smooth and solid.  Once you go Weber, you never go back.
Results.Title: Weber = Quality

Results.ReviewText: Well designed for ease of storage and use.  The grates clean easily and stay hot during cooking.  The lid works great and provides more flexibility in what you can cook.  We use in our RV and don’t have to sacrifice quality. Overall very happy so far.
Results.Title: Great grill for our RV.

Results.ReviewText: Good grill for small places and the road. This is my third one over many years.
Results.Title: Good Grill

Results.ReviewText: So far so good. Not a bad grill. It would be nice if they made a tin foil insert for the inside to make clean up easier.
Results.Title: So far so good

Results.ReviewText: I am returning a weber q1200 - again. I bought one last fall and it was working great until a few weeks ago. It got used several times a week on our patio. The gas was not getting to the burner to light. I am religious about keeping it clean, making sure the burner holes are clear. One day it just would not light - no gas to the burner. The 5 gallon propane was full. That tank worked on my Nepoleon grill. I bought a new hose, still no gas to the burner. So I bought another Q1200 grill. This one worked for 2 weeks, then again - no gas getting to the burner. Verified it was not the tank or hose. I bought a gas sniffer detector just to verify if any gas was getting through. I saw on line about what to do to "reset" the regulator attached to the grill. Still no gas got to the burner. Also online saw that these grills having the regulator built in the grill fail alot of times. The only was the grill would work was when I attach the small propane cylinder to the grill. Not acceptable to only work with a small cylinder and not the refillable  (or tank exchange) method. So I am getting another Nepoleon travelpro 285 grill. I cannot trust that the weber q1200 will always work anymore with 5 gallon propane tanks.
Results.Title: Two q1200 grills fail in same way in a month

Results.ReviewText:
I bought the 1200 18 months ago. I used it 3 times. THREE TIMES!! The regulator puked out. It is in-operable. Needs a new regulator to fire up past warm at best.
John Tomasini
Results.Title: POOR PARTS

Results.ReviewText: This is the third Weber Q I have owned and I have loved every one of them. Also gave one to my stepdaughter for a wedding gift.  They are so easy to use, and I use mine nearly every day.  With my last one, after several years I needed a replacement burner tube and Weber sent me one for free, which I thought was outstanding service.  I highly recommend these little barbecues!!!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200
